text:
```yaml
name: Dependency Review

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  dependency-review:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4.1.0
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Dependency Review
        uses: actions/dependency-review-action@v3.0.0
        with:
          fail_on_severity: high
```
